items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of primary screening using a rotating drum screen;

The Facility is a membrane bioreactor (MBR) system capable of treating up to 50,000 gallons per day (gpd). The treatment system consists of ... a biological and tertiary treatment vessel (anaerobic treatment chamber for denitrification, aerobic treatment chamber for nitrification and membrane filter for microfiltration) ;

A lined, impervious emergency storage basin with a capacity of approximately 300,000 gallons is available for emergency storage.
Biosolids are collected in a 50-gallon plastic container and disposed off-site.

Disinfected tertiary treated wastewater is discharged to either land or to surface water. When discharging to land (1 May – 30 September) the effluent is conveyed to the concrete wet well where it is disposed to land (7.5 -acre spray field with native grasses and trees) via a sprinkler system.
